title: Asset-poverty measurement definitions
description: Definitions for the original household estimates.
dataPeriod: Source metadata and explicitly dated 2020 example
methodology: Paraphrase of original provider metadata; no new estimate or threshold calculation.

source.title: Prosperity Now Scorecard: asset and liquid asset poverty
source.note: Original application build 2025.04.21. Provider data-year labels are preserved.
source.rights: Factual statistics with source attribution; original provider explanatory prose is retained internally and paraphrased here.

values.label: Asset poverty
values.definition: Household net worth is below the amount needed to cover three months at the poverty threshold without income.
values.note: Net worth includes durable wealth such as a home or business, which may need to be sold. This measure differs from annual income poverty.

values.label: Liquid asset poverty
values.definition: Household liquid assets are below the amount needed to cover three months at the poverty threshold without income.
values.note: The provider includes cash, bank accounts, stocks, mutual funds and specified retirement accounts; excludes equity in businesses, vehicles, homes and other real estate.

values.label: Household-size benchmark
values.definition: The benchmark depends on household size and the threshold period used by the source.
values.note: The current explanatory copy gives a four-person 2020 example of USD 6,550. That example is retained as context and is not relabelled as a 2021 threshold.

values.definition: Current Ohio and US values are labelled 2021 by the Scorecard; historical trend fields carry their own year labels.
values.note: The state source is labelled Survey of Income and Program Participation. Missing/suppressed trend values use -1. Provider fields ending _moe are retained literally without an inferred confidence level or unit.
